subject: Rebook technical deep-dive — final request to lock a slot
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@vertex.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + next step (technical deep-dive)

Hi Alex — thanks again for taking time on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- What we heard: primary goal is to reduce inference cost for batch scoring while keeping P95 latency under 300ms; sensitive PII in inputs requires VPC/private deployment for model hosting.
- Success criteria: prototype in staging with 2 models + perf baseline, estimate 40% token-cost reduction via batching/caching, pre-flight SOC2 evidence for procurement.
- Owners: Alex (Vertex) — product; Jordan (Redwood) — solutions; Ben (Redwood) — infra/POC ops.

We should lock a technical deep-dive with engineering to align on environment, data sampling, and rollout plan. Can you confirm one of these tight windows? If we don’t hear back in 48 hours we’ll release the slots: 

1) Wed 24 Mar — 09:00–09:45 PT (engineer + infra)
2) Wed 24 Mar — 14:00–14:45 PT (engineer + solutions)
3) Thu 25 Mar — 11:00–11:45 PT (fallback)

Attached: discovery-notes-vertex.txt (quick call notes). Proposed agenda and draft runbook to follow. Please include your procurement contact if you want pricing/contract discussion in the same session.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Jordan — really appreciate the recap and the crisp asks. Apologies, I had to step out for an emergency and missed following up sooner. We definitely want the deep-dive; the team needs a tighter window though because our lead engineer is on rotation.

I can do one of the following: 
- Wed 24 Mar — 14:00–14:45 PT (works best)
- Thu 25 Mar — 08:30–09:15 PT (earlier than your options)

If you can make the Wed 14:00 slot that’s ideal — I’ll loop in Samantha (procurement) once we lock. If neither works, we might need to push to the week of 29th. Also — could you send the technical agenda so I can share with my engineer ahead of time?

Thanks, Alex

Thanks Alex — Wed 24 Mar 14:00 PT works for our team. We’ll run a focused 40–45 minute session:

Agenda (attached TD_agenda_v2.pdf):
- 5m intro + success criteria (Jordan)
- 15m infra & data needs (Ben)
- 15m model serving performance (Marissa)
- 5–10m rollouts, security, next actions (Jordan)

Two asks before we lock calendar: 
1) Please confirm Samantha Chu (procurement) is OK to be included in the invite or share an alternate procurement contact.
2) Can you confirm the lead engineer’s name so we add them to the invite (we’ll keep it technical and leave pricing to procurement).

Note: we’ve only got two engineer-heavy slots left this week so we’ll release them if not confirmed in 24 hours. Once you confirm we’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read with sampling checklist.

Attachments: TD_agenda_v2.pdf
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765 (deal D-2026-0471)

Best — Jordan
